content.short: Rarible Mulitchain SDK is a multichain development tool for building NFT apps.
content.description: Rarible Multichain SDK is an open-source development tool designed for building NFT marketplaces and applications across multiple blockchains. Developers can use the SDK to create NFT collections, mint and sell NFTs, query NFT data, and transfer tokens, among other capabilities. By providing a unified abstraction layer across supported blockchains, it reduces on-chain programming complexity and makes it easier to interact with blockchain logic. Its modular design supports cross-chain workflows, enabling faster prototyping and deployment of cross-chain NFT apps.
